                - SYS_PTRACE
                - SYS_CHROOT
              privileged: false

              runAsNonRoot: true
              readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            resources:
              requests:
                cpu: 100m
                memory: 128Mi
              limits:

                memory: 256Mi
          volumes:
          - name: drupal-persistent-storage
            persistentVolumeClaim:
              claimName: composites-lib-unb-ca
